_comment: EXPERIMENT: optional extra quests. Not original game content. Stage lists name BOTH worlds where a place exists twice (Asuka and Amaterasu), and night/story variants count as the same place, so a quest works whichever world the story is in. Species, stage ids, coordinates and item names are checked against the game's own data by tools/check_quests.py. 'acceptAt' makes a quest acceptable only while standing in that place (a notice board, in effect).

quests.title: Central Park pest control
quests.text: Kunemon keep wandering into Central Park. Thin them out.

quests.title: Wire Forest survey
quests.text: Walk the Wire Forest entrance and the forest beyond it, and report back.

quests.title: East Station bounty: forest greens
quests.text: Plants are overrunning the Kicking Forest path. Cut four of them back.

quests.title: South Station bounty: swamp pests
quests.text: The Bulk Swamp crossing is infested. Clear four of the worst offenders.

quests.title: The quiet route
quests.text: Couriers lose time to fights in the Wire Forest. Show a fight-free way through.

objectives.label: Cross the Wire Forest entrance from the north-west gate to the south gate without a fight

quests.title: Card ladder: first steps
quests.text: Prove yourself at the card table. Beat any three tamers.

quests.title: Card ladder: rising duelist
quests.text: Word is spreading. Beat six tamers in all.

quests.title: Double trouble in Central Park
quests.text: Two pests came out of the long grass at once. Face a Kunemon and a Tapirmon back to back, with no time to heal in between.

objectives.label: Beat a Kunemon and then a Tapirmon, back to back

quests.title: Seiryu's rematch
quests.text: Word is the Seiryu leader's team will take on all comers again. The same three fighters, in the same order.

objectives.label: Beat the three fighters in a row

quests.title: Seiryu's rematch: the hard way
quests.text: The same three fighters, but they have been training. Stronger and tougher.

objectives.label: Beat the three trained fighters in a row

quests.title: Three leaders, one afternoon
quests.text: Take on the Seiryu, Suzaku and Byakko teams one after another. No healing between rounds.

objectives.label: Beat all three leaders' teams in a row (eight fights)

quests.title: Circuit Board cartographer
quests.text: The underground Circuit Board boards are not on any map. Chart six different ones.

quests.title: Before and after
quests.text: The Main Lobby is not always the same place. See it as it is now, and again once the city has changed.

objectives.label: Visit the Main Lobby once as Asuka City and once as Amaterasu City

quests.title: Arena qualifiers
quests.text: Three qualifier matches, back to back, on the arena floor. The game's own tournament rounds were never filled in; these are new.

objectives.label: Win three qualifier matches in a row on the arena floor
